axes: Minecraft axes: [x, y, z] with y up from the structure's floor (0 = floor level, negatives hang below), x east, z south; origin at the structure's centre. The tower's front stairs face north (-z).
block_names: texture names used in Blender: mod blocks by their texture id, vanilla blocks by id

A3 turbine.note: spins about its vertical axis, one turn every 20 s; render it as a display entity or a block-display group; its blocks are placed with y from 20 (it sits at 20.5 in Blender, half a block up)

A3 turbine mark.note: the Hope mark plates through the turbine's hub; they spin with the turbine (parent: A3 turbine)
